indistinguishable_from.claim: at the SAME LH/FSH profile the fasting artefact is indistinguishable from true deficiency — the pituitary axis cannot tell them apart

confounders._why: QE F1 (MEASURED 2026-08-05): `fast_washout_hours` was declared in SamplingConditions and documented as mattering 'as much as the fast', yet NO registry entry read it. `fasting_hours=4, fast_washout_hours=4` — a draw four hours after a 56 h fast ended — evaluated to conditions_verified, interpretable:true, no caveat, and went to the interpretation engine. ADR-002's decision table names washout-violated as a first-class blocked reason; nothing shipped under any name. `fasting_hours` measures the CURRENT fast and answers a different question: the moment a prolonged fast ends, `fasting_hours` resets and the artefact does not.

effect_magnitude.at: an OPEN washout window after a prolonged fast — an UPPER BOUND carried over from the fast's own measured figure, not a separate measurement of the residual; the decay curve is unmeasured by this repo

source.citation: Step-0 brief, ha-slice-b + references/preanalytical-variation.md — «the washout matters as much as the fast», which is where the 48 h window comes from: it is set EQUAL to the fast threshold of the entry above, on the brief's own words. CLAIMED, and doubly so — neither the window length nor the size of the residual has been measured by this repo. The withhold is therefore justified by the UNKNOWN, not by the number.

indistinguishable_from.claim: a value drawn while the washout window is still open carries the same artefact as one drawn during the fast, and the pituitary axis cannot separate either from true deficiency

source.citation: Step-0 brief, ha-slice-b (5 h/night across a week ⇒ −10…−15 %; CLAIMED — field case)

effect_magnitude.at: peaks 2–6 d after strenuous eccentric exercise, as high as ~30×ULN in high responders; still elevated up to ≈168 h

source.citation: Post-exercise CK variability: a literature review (PMC12161516); MDedge, 'How much can exercise raise CK level' — CK rises within 24 h, peaks 2–6 d (as high as ~30×ULN in high responders, but highly variable), normalises over ~7 d; guidance is to avoid strenuous exercise 2–7 d pre-test. Magnitude is an upper bound, not a universal value. SAFETY: a caveat only qualifies interpretation — it never suppresses the number, so a rhabdomyolysis-level CK still surfaces for urgent evaluation. No numeric PubMed ID asserted beyond the PMC handle.
